title: Britney Spears Says Goodbye To Instagram
htmlContent:
The legend of both Britney Spears and Elton John are tales of a long road to where they are now, with many bumps along the way. Thankfully, both stars have made it to the other side of hardship. The two have teamed up for a new song, which has the world love what they are doing and singing along.

In a recent Instagram post, Britney Spears sent a very long message as she thanked Elton John for having her work on a new song with him. In the letter, Britney ensured to thank Elton and ask him out for tea sometime when he was free.

The message is full of what an American considers typical English verbiage. You can see the post below. The news was posted on her Instagram before she deleted her Instagram account due to wanting to focus more on reality rather than basing happiness or sadness on the internet and the trolls that are abundant on such.

The pop star started to sage herself of negativity as she deactivated her social media account again Wednesday and explained shortly after that she aims to have a drama-free life.

She said: “I’m learning every day is a clean slate to try and be a better person and do what makes me happy … yes, I choose happiness today,” she tweeted. “I tell myself daily to let go of the hurt bitterness and try to forgive myself and others for what may have been hurtful.”

Spears, 40, told her 55.8 million Twitter followers that she wants “to be fearless like when [she] was younger and not be so scared” all the time.

Her Instagram came to an end with a message of: “I pray there actually is truth to the Holy Spirit and I hope that spirit is with my children as well !!!” she concluded, referencing her sons, Sean Preston, 16, and Jayden James, 15. “Yes … I choose happiness and joy today ☀️ !!!”

Credit - Page Six.
